name: comp-142
title: Checkbox With Expansion
blurb: Checkbox that expands to reveal an input field when checked.
description: Checkbox with description that reveals a text input when checked. Input auto-focuses on expansion and disables when unchecked. Uses CSS grid for smooth height animation.
use_when: Forms where additional input is only needed when a condition is met.
a11y: Checkbox controls the input via aria-controls. Input aria-labeled by checkbox. Region role marks expandable area. Full keyboard support.
